comments.value: Hey @{62cea1224517083b068f949b|full_name}, any update on this? I recently released a game world and need it to be known that I've updated it with patches. Yeah I can have an inworld update list (I do already), but without it being added to the "Recently Updated" section, traffic is a lot lower.

comments.mergedPostDetails:
This is especially bad because these worlds won't land in "Recently updated" section of Worlds.

E.g. 

Blackout by Ostinyo had very recent updates to the game, but the "Last updated" date is 1 month old rn.

Luminescent Ledge by Thorinair had an update recently as well, but the date is stuck at 10-2022.

I just tried pushing a new version of one of my old worlds and it's stuck with 2022 date (wrld_a52f7bee-3288-4854-9321-ffcaa3fd5b00)
comments.mergedPostTitle: For some worlds the "Last updated" date doesn't update

I'm surprised VRChat hasn't tracked this down yet. If you search this place the oldest report is from 2021

Reproduction of the bug might be the problem. I regularly visit worlds that have recently updated according to the system

@{5fcffbd1eac7313746724ea1|full_name}: Well, we are still looking into it and it is considered a top priority issue at the moment, but unfortunately it has proved particularly difficult to track down. So, for the time being no update, but not because we aren't working on it!
@{62cea1224517083b068f949b|full_name}: I'd say that's a pretty good update on the situation, at the very least. Thank you~♪
@{638138070a32e61e3d0b36c6|full_name}: Aww, looked promising at first, worked for one of my worlds, but not another, both cross platform.
@{5f95e537e096a8402955bf6d|full_name}: yeah, i tried it again yesterday and it didn't work, so either its just a coincidence, it's limited like time and such, or just random idk

I've been affected by this for a long time. I just updated wrld_96fbdad0-d3f1-4f86-84d9-7c2bb5ff4c73, following the suggestion of adding random gameobjects during the publish menu that others posted. This succeeded in changing the Last Updated date. First time I tried it, so I'm not sure if it'll persist.

Doing the 'add a random GameObject during the publish menu' strategy worked again once for another one of my worlds on 6/06, but has ceased to work again since. I tried it multiple times on other worlds that day, and on multiple different days since. No success.
@{5b12d42e9ad122540bc69858|full_name} Thanks for the ping on Discord. This appears to be working as expected for The Great Pug now!
After some confirmations from people previously affected by this, I'm happy to say this should now be fixed!
Can confirm that my worlds updated on the first try. Good work, y'all!

I can confirm as well that my world was able to update properly.

Thanks for fixing this issue!
